systemManagement.pageDescription: Centrally manage operating hours, holidays, maintenance settings, and security policies.
systemManagement.saveSuccess: System configuration has been saved successfully.
systemManagement.inquirySaveSuccess: Inquiry and notification settings have been saved.
systemManagement.inquirySaveError: Failed to save inquiry and notification settings.

operations.hoursDescription: Configure operating days and business hours for customer service.
operations.lunchDescription: Displays an away notice on the 1:1 inquiry widget during lunch breaks.
operations.holidayDescription: Specified dates are automatically treated as non-working days for customer support.

maintenance.title: System Maintenance
maintenance.temporaryDescription: Configure temporary maintenance windows or activate immediately.
maintenance.temporaryMessagePlaceholder: e.g., System maintenance is currently in progress. Services will resume shortly.
maintenance.recurringMessagePlaceholder: e.g., Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. Services will resume shortly.

security.registrationDescription: Configure whether new users are allowed to sign up for the service.
security.registrationAllowedDesc: New user registration is currently enabled. Anyone can create an account.
security.registrationBlockedDesc: New user registration is currently disabled. Only invited or admin-registered users can access the system.
security.sessionDescription: Configure idle session timeout, concurrent login restrictions, and account lockout.
security.preventConcurrentLoginDesc: Immediately invalidates existing sessions when logging in from another device.
security.passwordDescription: Configure minimum password length, special character requirements, and expiration period.
security.requireSpecialCharDesc: Enforces at least one special character in the password.

inquiry.policyDescription: Configure thresholds for unanswered inquiry alerts and automatic closure.
inquiry.unansweredHelper: Alert is triggered if inquiry remains unanswered for {{minutes}} minutes.
inquiry.autoCloseDesc: Time after which inactive completed inquiries are automatically closed.
inquiry.autoCloseHelper: Auto-closes after {{hours}} hours without follow-up questions.
inquiry.autoCloseHelperHoursOnly: Auto-closes after {{hours}} hours without follow-up questions.
inquiry.notificationDescription: Configure channel and webhook URL to receive notifications for new or unanswered inquiries.
inquiry.notificationEnabledDesc: Sends real-time alerts to the designated messenger when new inquiries are submitted or unanswered.
inquiry.notificationDisabledDesc: Admin notifications are currently disabled. Webhook alerts will not be sent.
inquiry.webhookDesc: Enter incoming webhook URL for the selected channel.
inquiry.testWebhookFailed: Failed to send test webhook. Please check your Webhook URL and channel status.
inquiry.webhookUrlRequired: Please enter a webhook URL to test.

notification.emailDescription: Configure email delivery via standard SMTP protocol (Port 587/465) compatible with AWS SES, NHN Cloud, Gmail, and custom mail servers.
notification.testFail: Failed to send test email. Please check your configuration.
notification.testSmsFail: Failed to send test SMS. Please check your configuration.
notification.testPushFail: Failed to send test push notification. Please check your configuration.
notification.testMessengerFail: Failed to send test messenger notification. Please check your configuration.
notification.smtpPassDesc: Leave blank to keep existing password when updating.
notification.messengerDescription: Select and configure your primary business messaging provider (Kakao Alimtalk, LINE, WhatsApp, Telegram, or WeChat).
notification.smsDescription: Configure SMS provider credentials for identity verification and urgent notification messages.
notification.pushDescription: Configure web and mobile push delivery credentials across major cloud providers.
